title: cNMF pipeline - samplesheet
description: One row per cNMF run. Give metadata + subset to subset the counts and select HVGs with topometry, or give hvgs to start from prep.

counts.errorMessage: counts must be an existing .h5ad file with no spaces in its path

metadata.description: obs column to subset by, e.g. ctype
metadata.errorMessage: metadata must be a single obs column name with no spaces

subset.description: Value of the metadata column to keep, e.g. MEL
subset.errorMessage: subset must be a single value with no spaces

k_vals.description: Numbers of components (k), separated by spaces or ';'. Default: --k_vals
k_vals.errorMessage: k_vals must be whole numbers separated by spaces or ';', e.g. "20 30 40"

n_iters.errorMessage: n_iters must be a whole number of at least 1

hvgs.description: Gene list, one gene per line. Required when metadata/subset are not given
hvgs.errorMessage: hvgs must be an existing file

run_name.description: Run name. Default: cnmf_{metadata}_{subset}_{YYYYMMDD}, or cnmf_{counts name}_{YYYYMMDD}
run_name.errorMessage: run_name must be unique and contain no spaces

errorMessage.dependentRequired: metadata and subset must be given together
errorMessage.required: counts is required, and hvgs is required when metadata/subset are not given
